name: hackintosh-skills
description: Tinjau dan rawat konfigurasi EFI Hackintosh (OpenCore): audit BIOS, validasi konfigurasi, pengumpulan bukti log, pemasangan driver, peningkatan versi sistem, tema pemilih boot, pergantian model SMBIOS, dan tiga kode board.
description_en: Hackintosh (OpenCore) EFI configuration audit & maintenance: BIOS audit, config verification, log forensics, driver installs, OS upgrades, boot-picker theming, SMBIOS switching and board serials.

plugins.name: opencore-config-audit
plugins.description: Tinjau, ubah, dan rawat konfigurasi OpenCore EFI Hackintosh beserta pemasangan driver-nya: audit BIOS/UEFI, verifikasi per kunci terhadap dokumentasi resmi, inspeksi ACPI/SSDT (AcpiSamples resmi + perpustakaan contoh hotpatch 5T33Z0/OC-Little-Translated), pengoptimalan kext, pembaruan kext dan OpenCore (build yang dikunci vendor vs build dari build-repo Dortania), pengumpulan bukti log boot dan waktu boot, alur debug berlapis saat macOS tidak bisa terpasang atau boot, perencanaan peningkatan versi besar macOS (termasuk pembagian versi kext jaringan lewat MinKernel/MaxKernel), pemblokiran disk, serta NVIDIA / Wi-Fi Intel / MediaTek (Sunrise native + Sunrise Pack MT7922 + skema kemasan + fork SimpleMtkWlan) / kartu Broadcom, audio AppleALC (termasuk pemulihan AppleHDA di macOS 26; layout kustom lewat 5T33Z0/AppleALC-Guides), HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost (★ DataProvider terbaik), aktif/nonaktifkan E-core, pemulihan izin TCC saat AMFI dinonaktifkan (tcc-helper), nama tampilan CPU (revcpuname), injeksi memori, tiga kode SMBIOS dan fitur driver/perangkat keras lainnya, serta tampilan antarmuka boot (tema OpenCanopy: set ikon, PickerAttributes, Flavour, label/font/audio/latar belakang) dan **pergantian model SMBIOS / tiga kode** (★ selesaikan SSDT dulu → baru ganti model → baru kerjakan ulang CPUFriend; mencakup SSDT OEM motherboard dan akar masalah AE_NOT_FOUND).
plugins.description_en: Audit, edit and maintain a hackintosh OpenCore EFI configuration and its driver installs: BIOS/UEFI settings audit, per-key verification against the official docs, ACPI/SSDT review against the official AcpiSamples and the 5T33Z0/OC-Little-Translated hotpatch library, kext trimming, deciding whether to update kexts/OpenCore, boot-log and boot-timeline forensics, layered debugging when macOS won't boot, major macOS upgrade planning (including per-Darwin-version kext gating with MinKernel/MaxKernel), disk masking, plus NVIDIA / Intel WiFi / MediaTek (native Sunrise + MT7922 Sunrise Pack + SimpleMtkWlan fork) / Broadcom cards, AppleALC audio (incl. restoring AppleHDA on macOS 26; custom layouts via 5T33Z0/AppleALC-Guides), HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost (best-practice CPUFriend data), E-core enable/disable, TCC permission recovery when AMFI is disabled (tcc-helper), CPU display-name override, memory injection SMBIOS/serials, OpenCanopy boot-picker theming, and SMBIOS model switching with board serials (finish SSDT first, then SMBIOS, then CPUFriend).
